messages:
lina: Quick thread  dropping a "Velvet Night" dark pass. Goal: softer contrast for long sessions, ensure code at 12px monospace stays crisp, and make small inline charts readable on thumbnails. Thoughts?

lina: tentative tokens:
- --velvet-900: #0a0b0d (canvas)
- --panel-800: #0f1113
- --card-600: #15171a
- --fg: #e6eaee
- --muted: #a3acb2
- --accent: #4fb8ff
- --warm-acc: #ffb57a

theo: nice. my main worry: legend chips and tiny axis labels vanish on 10" screens. suggest `--chip-bg: rgba(0,0,0,0.22)` and a 1px inner stroke `rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`.

rachel: contrast quick check: fg on velvet-900 = ~7.2:1 good. muted is ~3.5:1 so keep for microcopy only. we should mandate muted not be used for >12px labels.

sam: syntax palette proposal (low-sat, slightly warm accents): keywords `#86cfff`, strings `#ffd6a1`, functions `#cdb7ff`, types `#bdecd8`. avoid bright greens. also try reducing blue saturation by 10% so charts feel calmer.

lina: charts: prefer tonal cascades not saturated sets. Example series: `#4fb8ff`, `#6aaed1`, `#8fbfdc`. fills at 8-12% alpha. axis lines use `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` per theo.

theo: tiny CSS I pushed to Storybook:```css
:root{--velvet-900:#0a0b0d;--fg:#e6eaee;--chip-bg:rgba(0,0,0,0.22);--axis:rgba(255,255,255,0.05)}
.legend .chip{background:var(--chip-bg);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);padding:6px}
```

rachel: accessibility nit  focus states need visible fill, not just outline. propose `box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(79,184,255,0.12)` and ensure toggles have text labels for contrast. also add Storybook a11y test: body>=4.5, labels>=3.0.

sam: color-blind sim looks okay for deuteranopia but tertiary series collides on tiny legends. can we nudge its lightness +6%? i can post sim screenshots.

dev-bot: Preview build: https://preview.redwood.design/velvet-night-9 (build 417).

lina: copy tweak: change metric label "Latency" -> "P95 latency (ms)" in compact header. clearer for customers.

theo: UX idea: add a user-setting switch "Appearance: Soft / High contrast" that toggles `--muted` and grid alpha. I'll prototype a tiny control in the top-right.

rachel: +1; also add a PR checklist item to verify token usage against role (body vs microcopy).

sam: performance note: many alpha fills hurt canvas perf on streaming charts. prefer single-stroke lines for sparklines; area fills only on hover.

lina: plan: sam posts sims, theo wires the toggle, rachel adds Storybook checks. quick 10-min sync tomorrow to sign off. :calendar:

theo: will do a small branch and include the toggle with labels.

rachel: adding tests and PR template entry now.

sam: uploading sim shots and a tiny perf log.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from rachel, :rocket: from theo)
